items.text: On a 390px-wide phone the page doesn't scroll sideways (nothing reaches past the screen width).
Every keyboard (Tab) stop shows a visible focus indicator.
Every button, link and toggle has an accessible name (icon-only buttons included: dismiss banner, change avatar, copy and regenerate API key).
Every form field has a real label (<label>, aria-label or aria-labelledby), not just a placeholder.
The three notification settings are real checkboxes or switches that can be focused and toggled with the keyboard (Space).

Spacing and alignment are consistent in the screenshots: one spacing rhythm, labels and fields line up, the cards share widths and padding, and the type hierarchy (page title, section titles, labels, help text) is clear with readable contrast, at desktop and phone sizes.

Interactive states are designed rather than browser defaults: buttons and toggles have hover and focus styles, the destructive "Delete workspace" action looks clearly different from Save, and saving shows a clear success or error message.

Every original setting and action is still there and still wired up: full name, email (validated on save), avatar change button, trial banner with dismiss, workspace name, workspace URL slug with its quill.so/ prefix, the three notification settings (comment replies, weekly digest, product updates), masked API key with copy and regenerate (with its confirmation), Save, and Delete workspace (with its confirmation).

_note: Script items build the app, serve dist/ with `vite preview` and probe it in headless Chromium. Generated from one probe prelude per item; keep the five in sync.
